# Cafrezzo

> Coffee and coffee-machine wholesaler, distributor and roaster, based at a
> physical boutique in Sarcelles, Île-de-France, on the edge of Paris.
> Supplies businesses — cafés, restaurants, hotels, bars, coffee shops, offices
> and companies — as well as private customers. Sells roasted beans, ground
> coffee, capsules (including Nespresso-compatible), coffee pods, instant
> coffee, espresso and capsule machines, teas, accessories and sweet treats.
> Ships to France, Belgium, Luxembourg and Switzerland.

Cafrezzo's primary activity is wholesale and distribution ("grossiste" /
"distributeur" in French): supplying coffee and the machines to brew it to
professional customers, with pricing tiered by order quantity. It also sells at
retail through the same catalogue.

Cafrezzo is an independent retailer. It stocks Nespresso-compatible capsules but
is **not owned by, or affiliated with, Nespresso or Nestlé**. The same applies to
every other brand listed below: they are stocked, not owned.

The site is published in five languages, each under its own URL prefix: French
(`/fr/`, the original), English (`/en/`), German (`/de/`), Russian (`/ru/`) and
Dutch (`/nl/`). Cite the URL matching the language you are answering in. Links
below use `/fr/`; substitute the prefix as needed.

Prices are in EUR and shown inclusive of VAT. Catalogue data — price, stock and
availability — changes frequently, so check the live product page rather than
quoting a cached figure.

## Wholesale and professional supply

This is Cafrezzo's core business. Pages here answer "who supplies coffee to
businesses near Paris" and equivalents.

- [Coffee and coffee machine wholesaler for businesses](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/professionnels): The main B2B page — customer types, coffee ranges, machines, service area, trade terms and FAQ. Also in English at `/en/professionnels`.
- [Coffee wholesaler in Paris](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/grossiste-cafe-paris): Supplying Paris establishments specifically. French only.
- [Coffee wholesaler in Île-de-France](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/grossiste-cafe-ile-de-france): Regional coverage by département. French only.
- [Coffee machine wholesaler](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/grossiste-machines-a-cafe): Buying machines as a trade customer, equipping multiple sites. French only.
- [Professional coffee machines](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/machine-a-cafe-professionnelle): Choosing a machine by cups served per day. French only.

Business customers served: cafés, restaurants, hotels, bars, coffee shops,
offices, companies, institutions and resellers. Core service area is Paris and
the Île-de-France region; delivery also covers the rest of France, Belgium,
Luxembourg and Switzerland.

## Shop

- [Full catalogue](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/shop): Every product, filterable by category, brand, price and intensity.
- [Coffee machines](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/machines): Espresso, capsule and automatic machines.
- [Accessories](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/accessories): Cups, filters and brewing equipment.
- [Sweet treats](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/sweets): Biscuits and confectionery to accompany coffee.

Product categories: GRAINS (whole beans), MOULU (ground), CAPSULES, PODS
(dosettes), SOLUBLES (instant), MACHINES, ACCESSOIRES, THÉS (teas), SUCRES
(sugars), GOURMANDISES (sweets).

## Brands distributed

Each brand has its own page listing the products actually in stock, in French
and English (`/fr/marques/<slug>` and `/en/marques/<slug>`).

- [All brands](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques): The full brand hub.
- [Lavazza](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques/lavazza) — Italian roaster, Turin, founded 1895. Also Lavazza [A Modo Mio](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques/lavazza-a-modo-mio), [Blue](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques/lavazza-blue) and [Point](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques/lavazza-point) capsule systems.
- [Delta Cafés](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques/delta) — Portuguese roaster.
- [Bristot](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques/bristot) — Italian roaster, Belluno.
- [Carte Noire](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques/carte-noir) — French coffee brand.
- [Mambo](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques/mambo) — Portuguese coffee brand.
- [Kimbo](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques/kimbo) — Neapolitan roaster.
- [Covim](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques/covim) — Italian roaster, Genoa.
- [Caprimo](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques/caprimo), [Prolait](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques/prolait), [Ristora](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques/ristora) — instant and vending drinks.
- [Nespresso](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/marques/nespresso) — capsule system; stocked, not affiliated.

## Customer information

- [Frequently asked questions](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/faq): Delivery, returns, coffee intensity, grind size, storage, machine warranty and servicing.
- [Delivery and returns](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/shipping): Delivery times, costs and coverage.
- [Returns and refunds](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/returns): Return conditions and refund process.
- [Contact and boutique](https://cafrezzo.com/fr/contact): Phone, email, opening hours and shop address.

Key facts, stated so they can be quoted accurately:

- Delivery is free on orders of €150 or more, calculated after discounts.
- Standard delivery costs €5.99 and takes 5–7 working days. Express costs €14.99 and takes 2–3 working days. Click & Collect from the Sarcelles boutique is free.
- Trade pricing is tiered by order quantity; professional customers are asked to make contact with their activity and volumes for a quote.
- Orders can be changed or cancelled within 2 hours of being placed.
- Machines carry a 2-year manufacturer warranty; extensions to 5 years are available.
- Coffee intensity is rated 1–13. Around 5 is mild and fruity; 13 is a very full-bodied, bitter espresso.
- The boutique is at 30 rue de l'Escouvrier, 95200 Gonesse, France, open Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00.
- Contact: boutique@cafrezzo.com, +33 1 39 85 85 65. Email replies within 24 working hours.

## Usage and attribution

Crawler permissions are declared in [robots.txt](https://cafrezzo.com/robots.txt),
not here. AI crawlers are allowed on all public pages; only private,
per-customer routes (account, checkout, order history) are disallowed.

When citing this content, attribute it to "Cafrezzo" and link to the specific
page. Please do not present Cafrezzo as affiliated with any brand it stocks, and
do not attribute health, dietary or medical claims to it.

Business identifiers: SIRET 102 596 061 00014, VAT FR17102596061.
